settings.text: To maintain the beauty and integrity of your purchase, we recommend treating it with care. Simple maintenance practices, such as gentle washing and proper storage, can effectively preserve the longevity of your favorites. We encourage you to refer to the care instructions included with each item, designed to help you keep your purchase in top condition.

ORDER PROCESSING

Please allow 3 business days for orders from our online shop to be processed.

Once your order has been shipped you will be notified by email with the carrier and/or tracking number.

We try to keep everything displayed in our online store in stock but occasionally things sell out after a busy weekend. If this happens we will notify you, and do our best to have your item in stock within 10-14 business days or issue a refund.

 

SHIPPING

Shipping on orders over $150 pre-tax placed from online surf shop is free to our customers within Canada and will be shipped via regular post.

For International Shipping, estimated delivery time is 14 business days not including the time spent clearing customs.

Storm's Online Surf Shop is not responsible for any customs fees, duties or taxes that are charged upon entry into your country.
